documents.title: Microsoft 2025 Form 10-K
documents.locator: Note 1, Leases accounting policy; Note 13, Leases, supplemental balance-sheet and maturity tables, operating lease columns
documents.short_quote: Operating lease ROU assets and liabilities are recognized at commencement date based on the present value of lease payments over the lease term.
documents.factual_paraphrase: Operating lease liabilities are recognized at commencement at the present value of lease payments. At June 30, 2025, Microsoft reports operating lease liabilities of $22,861 million: $5,424 million current and $17,437 million noncurrent. Operating lease payments total $25,481 million before $2,620 million imputed interest. The maturity table lists $6,111 million in fiscal 2026. Finance leases are a separate column and outside this case.
